en: A sepia-toned vintage photograph showing a steam locomotive with several passenger carriages at a small railway station. Wooden sleepers and freight materials lie in the foreground beside the tracks, while telegraph poles run along the line. In the background are low town buildings and houses. The lower left corner bears the caption 'LATVIA', and the lower right corner is captioned 'ALŪKSNE' along with a small circular publisher's mark.
